done_when: Sign-off accepts a green full test run on a commit whose files match the latest default-branch commit, and still refuses when no such run passed

drop.because: Not a small fix: the pull request checks do not record a full-suite result sign-off can trust; the owner wanted only small changes in the hotfix

why: Client sign-off waits for a new full test run on the default branch after every merge, although the merged pull request already passed the full tests on the same files
